description: Longhorn distributed block storage: volume robustness and replicas (what gates tuppr node drains), node/disk capacity on the shared SSDs, backups, volume I/O and component resources. Metrics come from the longhorn-manager on each node (job="longhorn").

panels.title: Managers Down
panels.description: longhorn-manager pods (one per node) that Prometheus cannot scrape. All other panels go blank for the volumes and node owned by a manager that is down.

panels.title: Degraded Volumes
panels.description: Attached volumes running with fewer healthy replicas than configured. tuppr will not drain a node while any attached volume is degraded.

panels.title: Faulted Volumes
panels.description: Volumes with no usable replica left. Data is unavailable until a replica is salvaged.

panels.title: Detached Volumes
panels.description: Volumes not attached to any node (workload scaled down, or a Released/orphaned PV). Their robustness is reported as unknown; their replicas still occupy disk.

panels.title: Rebuilding Replicas
panels.description: Replicas in write-only (WO) mode, i.e. currently being rebuilt from a healthy replica.

panels.title: Replicas in Error
panels.description: Replica CRs in error state plus replicas the engine reports in ERR mode.

targets.expr: count(longhorn_node_status{job="longhorn"} == 0 or longhorn_disk_status{job="longhorn"} == 0 or longhorn_disk_health{job="longhorn"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Node/Disk Conditions Failing
panels.description: Longhorn node conditions (ready, schedulable, allowScheduling, required packages, ...), disk conditions (ready, schedulable) and SMART disk health that are currently false. A cordoned or draining node shows up here as allowScheduling/schedulable=false.

panels.title: Highest Disk Usage
panels.description: Fullest node's Longhorn disk, as used/capacity of the filesystem. Each node has one SSD shared by etcd, the OS and Longhorn; Longhorn stops scheduling replicas on a disk below 15% free.

panels.title: Backup Target
panels.description: Whether the default backup target (NFS on the NAS) is reachable from Longhorn.

targets.expr: count((time() - longhorn_volume_last_backup_at{job="longhorn"}) > 129600 and on (volume) (longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="attached"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Attached Volumes Without Recent Backup
panels.description: Attached volumes whose last successful backup is older than 36h (or that have never been backed up). The backup-daily recurring job should keep this at 0.

panels.title: Container Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in longhorn-system over the selected range.

targets.expr: max by (pvc_namespace, pvc, volume, node) ((longhorn_volume_robustness{job="longhorn", state="unknown"} * 0) or (longhorn_volume_robustness{job="longhorn", state="healthy"} * 1) or (longhorn_volume_robustness{job="longhorn", state="degraded"} * 2) or (longhorn_volume_robustness{job="longhorn", state="faulted"} * 3))

max by (pvc_namespace, pvc, volume, node) ((longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="creating"} * 1) or (longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="attached"} * 2) or (longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="detached"} * 3) or (longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="attaching"} * 4) or (longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="detaching"} * 5) or (longhorn_volume_state{job="longhorn", state="deleting"} * 6))

count by (volume) (longhorn_replica_info{job="longhorn"}) + on (volume) group_left (pvc_namespace, pvc, node) (0 * max by (pvc_namespace, pvc, volume, node) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{job="longhorn"}))

count by (volume) (longhorn_engine_replica_mode{job="longhorn", mode="RW"} == 1) + on (volume) group_left (pvc_namespace, pvc, node) (0 * max by (pvc_namespace, pvc, volume, node) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{job="longhorn"}))

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: One row per Longhorn volume. Replicas = replica CRs; RW Replicas = replicas the running engine reports as healthy read-write (blank for detached volumes). Node = node whose longhorn-manager owns the volume (the attached node when attached). Actual Size is the space one replica uses on disk.

panels.title: Volumes by Robustness
panels.description: unknown = detached volume (no engine running).

panels.title: Engine Replica Modes
panels.description: Replicas of attached volumes as seen by their engine. RW = healthy, WO = rebuilding, ERR = failed. A WO bump after a node reboot is the post-drain rebuild.

panels.title: Disk Usage per Node
panels.description: Used/total of the filesystem backing the Longhorn disk on each node (shared with etcd and the OS).

panels.title: Scheduled vs Schedulable
panels.description: Sum of the provisioned sizes of replicas scheduled on the node divided by (capacity - reserved). Longhorn refuses new replicas above storage-over-provisioning-percentage (200% here). Replicas of detached and Released volumes count too.

panels.title: Disk Usage over Time
panels.description: Used bytes per node vs the disk size and the part of it Longhorn may schedule into.

SMART data Longhorn reads from each node's disk. Raw vendor values: wearout and reserved block encodings differ between SSD models, so compare nodes and watch for changes rather than reading them as percentages. Reallocated/uncorrectable/CRC counts should stay 0.

targets.expr: max by (node, attribute) (longhorn_disk_health_attribute_raw{job="longhorn", attribute=~"Temperature_Celsius|Media_Wearout_Indicator|Reallocated_Sector_Ct|Reported_Uncorrect|UDMA_CRC_Error_Count|Unused_Rsvd_Blk_Cnt_Tot|Power_On_Hours|Power_Cycle_Count"}) or label_replace(max by (node) (longhorn_disk_health{job="longhorn"}), "attribute", "Longhorn Health", "", "")

panels.title: Disk Health (SMART)
Throughput (Top 5)
panels.description: Top 5 volumes per direction, as reported by the Longhorn engine (zero series are hidden; Longhorn reports these gauges per volume, not as counters).

panels.title: IOPS (Top 5)
panels.description: Top 5 volumes per direction, as reported by the Longhorn engine (zero series are hidden; Longhorn reports these gauges per volume, not as counters).

panels.title: Latency (Top 5)
panels.description: Average I/O latency per volume over Longhorn's sampling interval; top 5 per direction, zero series hidden.

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: instance-manager pods run the volume engines and replicas (the I/O data path); longhorn-manager is the control plane. Two instance managers per node means engines are still running in the previous version's instance manager after an upgrade.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of instance-manager and longhorn-manager containers (no memory limits are set in longhorn-system).

title: Longhorn
